paragraphs.en: The personal grievance provisions of New Zealand’s Employment Relations Act 2000 (ERA) prevent an employer from firing an employee without good cause. Instead, dismissals must be justified. Employers must both show cause and act in a procedurally fair way.
paragraphs.zh: 新西兰《2000年雇佣关系法》（ERA）中的个人申诉条款，禁止雇主在没有正当理由的情况下解雇员工。也就是说，解雇必须有充分依据。雇主既须说明理由，也须以程序公正的方式行事。

paragraphs.en: Personal grievance procedures were designed to guard the jobs of ordinary workers from “unjustified dismissals”. The premise was that the common law of contract lacked sufficient safeguards for workers against arbitrary conduct by management. Long gone are the days when a boss could simply give an employee contractual notice.
paragraphs.zh: 个人申诉程序的设计初衷，是保护普通劳动者的工作，使他们免遭“无正当理由解雇”。其前提是，普通法中的合同规则无法为劳动者提供充分保障，以防范管理层的任意行为。老板只须按合同规定提前通知员工，就能将其解雇的日子，早已一去不复返了。

paragraphs.en: But these provisions create difficulties for businesses when applied to highly paid managers and executives. As countless boards and business owners will attest, constraining firms from firing poorly performing, high-earning managers is a handbrake on boosting productivity and overall performance. The difference between C-grade and A-grade managers may very well be the difference between business success or failure. Between preserving the jobs of ordinary workers or losing them. Yet mediocrity is no longer enough to justify a dismissal.
paragraphs.zh: 但当这些规定适用于高薪经理和高管时，就会给企业带来困难。正如无数董事会和企业主能够证明的那样，限制企业解雇表现不佳、收入却很高的管理人员，就如同拉住了提高生产率和整体业绩的手刹。三流经理与一流经理之间的差别，很可能就是企业失败与成功之间的差别，也是普通员工失去工作还是保住工作之间的差别。然而，表现平庸已不足以成为解雇的正当理由。

paragraphs.en: Consequently—and paradoxically—laws introduced to protect the jobs of ordinary workers may be placing those jobs at risk.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，具有讽刺意味的是，原本为保护普通劳动者工作而制定的法律，反而可能使这些工作面临风险。

paragraphs.en: If not placing jobs at risk, to the extent employment protection laws constrain business owners from dismissing under-performing managers, those laws act as a constraint on firm productivity and therefore on workers’ wages. Indeed, in “An International Perspective on New Zealand’s Productivity Paradox” (2014), the Productivity Commission singled out the low quality of managerial capabilities as a cause of the country’s poor productivity growth record.
paragraphs.zh: 即便没有使工作岗位面临风险，只要就业保护法律限制企业主解雇表现欠佳的经理，这些法律就会制约企业生产率，进而压低劳动者工资。事实上，生产率委员会在2014年发布的《从国际视角看新西兰的生产率悖论》中，明确指出管理能力低下是该国生产率增长表现不佳的一个原因。

paragraphs.en: Nor are highly paid managers themselves immune from the harm caused by the ERA’S unjustified dismissal procedures. Because employment protection laws make it costlier to fire an employee, employers are more cautious about hiring new staff. This makes it harder for the marginal manager to gain employment. And firms pay staff less because firms carry the burden of the employment arrangement going wrong.
paragraphs.zh: 高薪经理本人也无法免受《雇佣关系法》中无正当理由解雇程序所造成的伤害。由于就业保护法律提高了解雇员工的成本，雇主在招聘新员工时会更加谨慎。这使得处于录用边缘的经理更难找到工作。而且，由于企业要承担雇佣关系出现问题所带来的负担，它们支付给员工的薪酬也会降低。

paragraphs.en: Society also suffers from excessive employment protections. Stringent job dismissal regulations adversely affect productivity growth and hamper both prosperity and overall well-being.
paragraphs.zh: 过度的就业保护还会使社会受损。严格的解雇规定会对生产率增长产生不利影响，并阻碍社会繁荣及整体福祉的提升。

paragraphs.en: Across the Tasman Sea, Australia deals with the unjustified dismissal paradox by excluding employees earning above a specified “high-income threshold” from the protection of its unfair dismissal laws. In New Zealand, a 2016 private members’ Bill tried to permit firms and high-income employees to contract out of the unjustified dismissal regime. However, the mechanisms proposed were unwieldy and the Bill was voted down following the change in government later that year.
paragraphs.zh: 在塔斯曼海的另一边，澳大利亚通过将收入超过特定“高收入门槛”的员工排除在不公平解雇法的保护范围之外，来应对无正当理由解雇制度的悖论。在新西兰，2016年一项由普通议员提出的法案，曾试图允许企业与高收入员工通过合同约定，不适用无正当理由解雇制度。然而，拟议的机制过于繁琐，该法案在当年稍晚政府更迭之后被投票否决。
